source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Survival parses
summary: Steady Shot weave, Serpent Sting maintained, Multi-Shot on cooldown. Expose Weakness (armor debuff on crits) is the primary raid contribution. Readiness resets all cooldowns on a 5-min timer.
_dev_note: Wrong-expansion guard (not user-facing): Explosive Shot and Kill Shot are WotLK abilities; if they ever appear in a log the parse is mislabeled.

Aspect of the Monkey.note: should be in Aspect of the Hawk for DPS - Monkey is melee avoidance only

Aspect of the Viper.note: sustained Viper use means running OOM - check consumables

Wing Clip.note: melee slow on a ranged DPS parse

Wyvern Sting.note: CC utility ability used as a filler - should not appear on a non-CC encounter

Volley.note: AoE channel on a single-target encounter

breakpoint.note: Survival's shot rotation is mechanically identical to BM - the difference is in the talent tree (Expose Weakness, Lightning Reflexes, Resourcefulness). A survival hunter parse that looks exactly like a BM parse is working correctly.

advisory: Expose Weakness procs on ranged crits and reduces the target's armor - this is a significant raid DPS contribution that doesn't show directly in the hunter's personal damage. Readiness (resets all cooldowns on a 5-min timer) enables a double-Rapid Fire burst window. Fight notes: on add-heavy phases (Karathress murlocs, Nightbane skeletons, Hydross adds) swap Multi-Shot weave for Volley and an Explosive Trap on the spawn point; use Misdirection on pulls to feed threat to the tank, and switch to Aspect of the Viper only when a fight's long downtime or movement (Vashj striders, Kael phases) is draining your mana.
